answer_1.quote: We train these models using the next token prediction objective for each finetuning corpus. For the instruction tuning task, loss is only based on response completion.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on training language models for next token prediction across medical domain tuning, instruction tuning (code outputs), and chat tuning (conversational responses).

answer_2.quote: On the PubMedQA dataset, we evaluated two Llama-3 8b models that were fine-tuned on the medical domain, one that was regularly trained and one with FF. We tested the models on a subset of 1K examples using few-shot in-context learning. The regularly trained model achieved an accuracy of 49.75%, whereas FF trained model achieved an accuracy of 50.95%.
